title: Cold Soda on Tap — Inside a Home Soda Machine
description:
The goal: cold, fizzy soda from a faucet at home. This animated tour follows the water through the integrated home soda machine I'm developing, from refrigeration and carbonation to two chilled flavors and the final pour. The flavors stay separate until they mix with the carbonated water in your glass.

Explore the design and follow the build:
https://homesodamachine.com
